sections.content:
| Issue | Impact | File |
|---|---|---|
| Sequential dynamic imports | High — adds 8 RTTs to every `createBridgeSession` call | `createSession.ts` |
| `isMultiSessionSpawnEnabled` uncached | High — async gate check in hot poll loop | `bridgeMain.ts` |
| `sessionDisplayInfo` unbounded | Medium — memory leak in long-running multi-session bridge | `bridgeUI.ts` |
| Shimmer grapheme segmentation | Medium — CPU waste on every 150ms animation tick | `bridgeStatusUtil.ts` |
| `getBridgeAccessToken` uncached | Low-Medium — OAuth keychain read on each API call | `bridgeConfig.ts` |
| `cleanup()` not in `finally` | Low — listener leak on normal sleep resolution | `capacityWake.ts` callers |
